body.intent: Fix rhiza rex install bakes the installing machine's absolute rhiza path into rhiza.lua (local BIN = "/Users/darinhaener/bin/rhiza"), but a Rex app runs on the host of its pane: with the Mac's Rex client working sessions on the VM's Rex server, the roadmap app failed with "rex-run: line 1: /Users/darinhaener/bin/rhiza: No such file or directory" (owner, 2026-11-03). The generated actions should run rhiza from the executing host's PATH (or resolve it there), not a path fixed at install time; a symlink at that path on the VM is the stopgap
